SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
File No.
No. D 4020
Special Branch S.2
Date 12/9/32
Date Sept. 15, 19 32.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT

Subject (in full) General Fan Shung-chi.

Made by. D.S. Moore. Forwarded by (签名)

The above named native of Szechuen and officer in the
Nationalist Army was a patient in the Shanghai General Hospital
under the care of Dr. W.E. O'Hara, from July 21, 1932 to
September 1, 1932, suffering from a fractured right arm received
as the result of a bomb explosion in the vicinity of Nanking.
According to report General Fan Shung-chi was wounded by a bomb
dropped from an aeroplane, reputed to belong to the Communist
forces, which visited the aera in which he was operating.

It is known that he was removed from Nanking to the
International Hospital at Hankow following his incapacitation.
Dr. O'Hara was commissioned to attend to him in Hankow, proceeding
to that city by aeroplane. After a few days he ordered the
removal of his patient to Shanghai. This was done, General
Fan arriving here by boat.

So far as is known, General Fan has no Shanghai address
and whilst a patient in the General Hospital, members of his
family resided at the New World Hotel, Thibet Road. It is
reported that General Fan left Shanghai a few days ago, with
the expressed intention of returning to Nanking to interview
General Chiang Kai-shek.

(签名: W.B. Moore. D.S.)
Officer i/c Special Branch.

(印: SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH 19 SEP 1932)

日期 1932年9月12日
日期 1932年9月15日。

上海公共租界工部局警务处
报告

事由（全称）范顺齐将军。

制作人：D.S. Moore。转发人（签名）

上述人士系四川籍，国民革命军军官，于1932年7月21日至1932年9月1日期间，在上海宏恩医院（Shanghai General Hospital）由 W.E. O'Hara 医生诊治，其右臂骨折，系在南京附近遭遇炸弹爆炸所致。据报，范顺齐将军被一枚据称属于共产党军队的飞机投下的炸弹炸伤，该飞机曾飞临其作战区域。

据悉，他在丧失行动能力后，从南京被转移至汉口的国际医院。O'Hara 医生受命前往汉口为其诊治，乘飞机抵达该市。数日后，他下令将病人转送至上海。此事已办妥，范将军乘船抵达此处。

据所知，范将军在上海无住址；在其于宏恩医院住院期间，其家属居住在西藏路的新世界酒店。据报道，范将军已于数日前离开上海，明确表示意图返回南京谒见蒋介石将军。

（签名：W.B. Moore. D.S.）
特别处主管。

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处特别处 1932年9月19日）

In the month of July
or August there was a
seaman from Scotland
treated for wounds by
Dr O'Hara in the
Shanghai General Hospital.
Please ascertain discreetly
his name and if possible,
Shanghai address.

D.S. More
OBK 14/9.

七月或八月间，有一名
来自苏格兰的海员在
上海宏恩医院接受
O'Hara 医生的伤口治疗。
请谨慎查明其姓名，
以及可能的上海住址。

D.S. More
OBK 9月14日。
